title: Graph-Coordinated Differentially Private Multi-Relational Data Synthesis
summary: A proof-of-concept pipeline that infers relational schemas, allocates a differential-privacy budget across a table dependency graph, and trains per-table DP-CTGAN models to synthesize multi-table datasets with relational integrity restored afterward. It calls SDV's demo-dataset downloader and SingleTableMetadata schema object to prepare and describe the relational demo dataset used for testing.
evidence: prepare_relational_demo_dataset.py:11-12 imports sdv.datasets.demo.download_demo/get_available_demos and sdv.datasets.local.load_csvs; module3_synthesis_engine.py:10 imports sdv.metadata.SingleTableMetadata
needs: Custom DP-CTGAN (dp_ctgan.py) is the actual synthesizer, not sdv.CTGANSynthesizer; SDV is used only for demo data acquisition and metadata schema, not the core generative model.
